fullDescription: A brutalist monochrome design system inspired by high-end editorial magazines and stark industrial interfaces. Characterized by high-contrast black-and-white palettes, thick 2px borders, and a sophisticated pairing of IBM Plex Serif and IBM Plex Sans. This style is ideal for SaaS design tools, developer environments, creative portfolios, and fintech dashboards that prioritize clarity, structural integrity, and a premium 'architectural' feel. It utilizes dashed overlays for interaction states and a rigid grid layout to maintain an organized yet aggressive aesthetic.

structured.summary: SpecOS Brutalist Monochrome: A stark, high-contrast design system utilizing a black-and-white palette, 2px solid borders, and dual-font typography (Serif/Sans) to create an editorial, industrial workspace aesthetic.

style.description: The style is strictly monochrome (#000000, #FFFFFF, and specific grays). It uses IBM Plex Serif for headers and semantic labels to provide an editorial feel, while IBM Plex Sans handles UI body text. Borders are a consistent 2px solid black. Interactive elements use a 'negative' hover state (black background with white text). Animations are sharp and purposeful, utilizing cubic-bezier curves for menu transitions and simple pulses for selection states.
style.prompt: Create a design with a strict monochrome palette: Black (#000000), White (#FFFFFF), and Grays (#F9FAFB, #E5E7EB, #9CA3AF). Typography: Use 'IBM Plex Serif' (weights 500, 600) for headers and component labels; use 'IBM Plex Sans' (weights 300, 400, 500) for body text and UI controls. Borders: Use solid 2px black (#000000) for all primary containers and buttons. Selection states: Use dashed 1px black borders for hovered items and solid 2px black borders with 8px square corner handles for selected items. Micro-interactions: Buttons and list items should invert colors on hover (bg-black, text-white). Context menus: Stark white background, 2px black border, no shadow, animation 'menu-in' (200ms, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)). Spacing: Generous, using multiples of 4px.

layout_and_structure.description: A tri-pane layout featuring a fixed top toolbar, a central canvas for content exploration, and a functional right-hand annotation panel. All sections are separated by 2px black horizontal or vertical rules.

prompts.prompt: Height 76px. White background with a 2px black bottom border. Left section: Group of 44x44px square buttons with 2px borders, containing monochrome icons. Middle section: AI Scan button, 44px height, solid black background, white text, sparkles icon. Right section: Action buttons (Share, Export) with 2px borders, 'Export' includes a chevron-down icon. Vertical separators are 1px black lines, 32px height.

Background #F9FAFB. Centered 16:10 aspect ratio container with a 2px black border. Inside: White background representing a web mockup. Mockup contains thin font-weight headers (300 weight), 1px gray bottom borders for navigation, and elements that trigger dashed 1px black overlays on hover.

Width 384px. Fixed position. 2px black left border. Header: Serif title with numeric count in parentheses, followed by status chips (TODO: empty square border, PROGRESS: gray square, DONE: black square). Body: Scrollable list of annotation cards. Cards are 2px black border when active, 1px gray when inactive. Cards feature a serif numeric index in a 28x28px black square.

Floating at the bottom-center of the canvas. White background, 2px black border, horizontal padding 24px, vertical padding 12px. Text style: 12px uppercase, tracking-wider, featuring keyboard keys wrapped in a monospace font with a thin border.

special_ui_components.description: A high-contrast semantic action menu for component-level operations.
special_ui_components.prompt: Width 260px. Background #FFFFFF. Border 2px solid #000000. Header section: Serif font H3, 11px uppercase subtitle, separated by 2px black line. Menu Items: Height 44px, flex layout, icon on left, text in IBM Plex Sans (light), keyboard shortcut in kbd tag on right. Primary action has a 4px black left-border accent. Hover state: background #000000, text #FFFFFF, icon #FFFFFF.

special_ui_components.description: Visual indicator for active selection on a canvas.
special_ui_components.prompt: A container with an absolute-positioned -12px offset. Border 2px solid #000000. At each of the four corners, place an 8x8px solid black square handle. Top-left includes a 28px height black label with white serif text indicating the component type (e.g., 'BUTTON'). Border should have a 2-second 'pulse-border' animation varying border-color between #000000 and #333333.

special_ui_components.description: Information card with status labels and hierarchy.
special_ui_components.prompt: Padding 16px. Border-2px solid #000000. Top-left: 28x28px black square with white serif text. Content: IBM Plex Sans Medium 14px for title, IBM Plex Sans Light 12px for description in #4B5563. Bottom tags: 10px uppercase tracking-widest text in 1px black border boxes. Hover state: Full card background becomes #000000, all text becomes #FFFFFF or #CCCCCC.

structured.special_notes: MUST maintain 2px border consistency for all structural elements. MUST NOT use any drop shadows or rounded corners. MUST use Serif font only for headers and specific metadata labels. MUST ensure all interactive elements have a high-contrast state change (e.g., White-to-Black inversion).
